name: Zhuo Wenjun
bio: Zhuo Wenjun was a woman of Linqiong, in what is now Sichuan, in the Western Han period. According to tradition she was the daughter of a wealthy family who eloped with the poet Sima Xiangru, and the two are among the best-known lovers in Chinese literary history.

Tradition credits her with the poem Bai tou yin ("Song of White Hair"), said to have been written when Sima Xiangru thought of taking a concubine, and to have persuaded him to change his mind. The attribution is traditional rather than certain: the poem survives in the Yutai xinyong anthology of the sixth century, and the dating is doubtful. Her birth year here is an approximation, used only for sorting.

poems.title: 白頭吟 (Bai tou yin)
poems.author: Zhuo Wenjun
poems.collection: Yutai xinyong (Jade Terrace New Songs), juan 1
poems.text:
皚如山上雪，皎若雲間月。
聞君有兩意，故來相訣絕。
今日斗酒會，明旦溝水頭。
躞蹀御溝上，溝水東西流。
凄凄復凄凄，嫁娶不須啼。
願得一心人，白頭不相離。
竹竿何嫋嫋，魚尾何蓰蓰。
男兒重意氣，何用錢刀為。
